decisions.action: Retain existing separate canonical species. Full accepted authorship and Hitchcock 1928 publication verified; no canonical edit.

decisions.rank: historical basionym as spelled in POWO
decisions.action: POWO lists Panicum scheelei Steud. (1853) as homotypic; IPNI and Rominger 1962 use Panicum scheelii Steud. Do not silently normalize both historical spellings as one nomenclatural record without checking the 1853 protologue.

decisions.rank: historical basionym spelling as linked by IPNI
decisions.action: IPNI explicitly links this spelling to accepted Setaria scheelei and marks the Panicum scheelii citation a duplicate. Rominger (1962, p. 52) also spells Panicum scheelii. Verify original Steudel 1853 protologue before adjudicating correct original orthography; preserve both source-specific spellings.
Historical combination dated 1922 in POWO; do not create another card.

POWO lists Scribn. & Merr. without parenthetical author and calls the name illegitimate/superfluous. ITIS writes '(Scheele) Scribn. & Merr.'; retain POWO form for POWO-specific evidence and flag author citation disagreement instead of claiming harmonized nomenclature.

POWO lists this 1849 Scheele name as an illegitimate later homonym; Rominger 1962 compares earlier Setaria polystachya Schrad. (1824). Never merge authorless 'Setaria polystachya' records without original author/protologue.
Preserve full author citation. Do not confuse with accepted Alopecurus geniculatus L., a different species.

decisions.source_name: Setaria scheelei photographic or hybrid identity
decisions.action: Accepted nomenclature and source synonyms do not authenticate any existing learner photograph or hybrid specimen. Preserve all original scientific HOLD/FAIL/UNRESOLVED decisions and do not assign hybrids from field appearance.
